intro: A full redesign of La Virginia’s e-commerce site, focused on improving navigation, visual clarity, and the overall shopping experience. The project involved restructuring the site’s information architecture and developing a visual design system aligned with the brand’s warm and traditional identity. With a user-centered approach, we optimized the journey from product exploration to checkout. UX principles were applied to streamline navigation, build user trust, and improve conversion. The result is a functional and visually appealing online store, ready to scale and strengthen the brand’s digital presence while enhancing user engagement.
media: User-centered UX and a refined design system.
